topic.label: Infrastructure
topic.desc: What software runs on: compute and runtimes, networking and DNS, infrastructure as code, containers and orchestration, and CI/CD pipelines.

concepts: Servers, virtual machines, serverless functions, edge workers and language runtimes, and sizing them.
Networks, DNS, load balancers, TLS certificates, firewalls and content delivery.
Declaring infrastructure in code: Terraform, modules, providers, state files and drift.
Container images, registries, Kubernetes clusters, pods, deployments and scaling.
Continuous integration and delivery: build, test and deploy pipelines, artifacts and release gates.
skills: Sizes compute for a workload (CPU, memory, instances or functions) and estimates cost.
Chooses a runtime (VM, container, serverless, edge) for a service and names the limits of each.
Traces the network path of a request from client to service and names where it can fail.
Checks the DNS records and TLS certificate setup for a domain.
Reviews an infrastructure plan for destructive changes, drift and security issues before it is applied.
Designs reusable infrastructure modules with inputs, outputs and defaults.
Reviews Kubernetes manifests for resource limits, probes, security context and scaling.
Plans a container image build: base image, layers, size and vulnerabilities.
Designs a build, test and deploy pipeline with gates between stages.
Diagnoses a failed pipeline run from its logs and names the likely cause.
mcp: Cloudflare MCP servers: Workers deployment and bindings, DNS, observability logs, edge compute and platform documentation.
HashiCorp Terraform MCP server: Terraform registry providers, modules and policies for infrastructure as code workflows.
Kubernetes MCP server: inspect and manage cluster resources, pods, deployments, namespaces, logs and Helm releases.
AWS Labs MCP servers: AWS documentation, infrastructure as code, cloud compute, serverless, cost and pricing analysis.
